description: This file defines the TransmissionManagerImpl class which implements TransmissionManager. It handles starting, stopping, and sending queries over a communication interface in a logging or ECU tuning context, utilizing logging, settings management, and query handling.

classes.name: TransmissionManagerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of TransmissionManager interface, responsible for managing transmission state and sending queries in an ECU logging context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the transmission manager, retrieves settings, and logs that the manager has started.

methods.name: sendQueries
methods.description: Sends a collection of ECU queries with a specified polling state, checking for null arguments.

methods.name: endQueries
methods.description: Ends the current batch of queries, prior implementation code is commented out.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the transmission manager and logs that it has stopped.
